verdict.rationale: Hightouch's docs mention a "built-in agent" that marketers can use to explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language. That is the product's own in-app assistant, but the evidence is a single sentence, and the delegable tasks shown are limited to exploration and analysis. The MCP server lets external AI assistants act on Hightouch, so it is not credited here as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of the in-app agent, evidence it can carry out actions (building audiences, syncs, journeys) inside the product, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
